title: Volume under a surface as a sum of columns
lede: Each column has a base of 2/n by 2/n and the height of the surface at one point of its cell. The sum of their volumes is compared with a fine-grid value.
notice: As n grows, the columns fit the surface more closely and the sum approaches the reference volume.
With the left-corner rule the error shrinks in proportion to 1/n, so error times n levels off. With the midpoint rule it shrinks like 1/n², and error times n² levels off.
With few columns the sum can sit well above or below the reference. Compare the left-corner and midpoint errors at the same n.
hint: Drag to rotate. Raise n and switch between the two rules.
